info.name: Stable Vitals API
info.description:
# Stable Vitals API

Phase 1 barn API, including water sensor readings. Sensor hardware is not required to run the backend.

## Run the collection
1. Start the API with `npm start`.
2. Import this collection and the **Stable Vitals — Local** environment.
3. Select that environment.
4. Open Collection Runner and run from top to bottom.

Signup stores the owner token. Password reset, near the end, verifies a one-time code and then logs in again. Creating a horse, alert, invite, or checkout stores the id used by the next request. Logout is last and checks that the token was revoked.

## Sensor readings
Set `SENSOR_API_KEY` in the server `.env` and set the matching `sensorApiKey` in the Postman environment. A device sends `POST /api/v1/sensor/readings` with `x-sensor-api-key` and JSON `{ "horseId": "...", "waterConsumedLiters": 2.5, "recordedAt": "2026-11-05T10:00:00.000Z" }`. `recordedAt` is optional; water consumed is in liters since the previous reading. The app reads history from `GET /api/v1/horses/:id/sensor-readings?limit=50` and latest from `GET /api/v1/horses/:id/sensor-readings/latest` using its bearer token. Use HTTPS and keep the sensor key secret in production.

## Roles
- `all_access` — owner. Horses, team, billing, and settings.
- `basic_access` — notes, care, alerts, and settings.
- `view_only` — only horses in `allowedHorseIds`.

## Payment
Checkout stays pending until `POST /api/v1/webhooks/payment` arrives with the `x-webhook-secret` header.
Use `payment.succeeded` or `payment.failed`.

item.name: Password reset
item.description: Request a 6-digit code, verify it, then set a new password. With SMTP configured, the code is emailed. Without SMTP, and outside production, the code is in the forgot-password response and saved as otp. Existing sessions stop working after the password changes, so this folder logs in again before logout.

request.description: Creates a 10-minute code for the owner email. SMTP delivery is used when SMTP_HOST is set. Otherwise the code is returned in this response and stored in otp.
Exchanges the 6-digit code for a reset token that lasts 15 minutes.
Sets the new password and signs out older tokens. The reset token works once.
Replaces the token that was signed out by the password change.
